Messages.Author: Morgan Vening
Messages.Body:
The recent 'Distant Eye' question brings up something I was curious
about, but kept forgetting to ask.

How do cards like Treachery interact with Kindred Coercion, Distant
Eye, and Michael Luther? Is the Methusalah controlling the vampire
considered to be responsible for their votes, even if not deciding? Or
is the Methusalah changing the vote responsible? Or is it a wash, and
neither is responsible?

Morgan Vening

Messages.Author: Daneel
Messages.Body:
On Sat, 26 Feb 2005 21:04:31 +1100, Morgan Vening <mor...@optusnet.com.au>
wrote:



The controller of the vampire takes full responsibility for everything
his or her minion does as long as it is under his control, even if
the control as not absolute at the moment.

--
Bye,

Daneel

Messages.Body:
